name: calendar
description: Month grid with ISO date keys, min/max bounds and full keyboard navigation.
designIntent: A native date input renders browser chrome that cannot be themed and differs per browser. Calendar is the visible grid behind a date field: controlled by ISO strings so a timezone cannot shift the chosen day, keyboard-operable cell by cell, and usable standalone or inside a Popover.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fired with the ISO key when a day is chosen.

props.name: today
props.description: Overrides the highlighted today, for deterministic rendering.

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP-47 locale for month and weekday labels.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: 0 starts the week on Sunday, 1 on Monday.

props.name: showOutsideDays
props.description: Show leading/trailing days from neighbouring months.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the active day on mount, for popover use.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every day and the month controls.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Overrides the grid label (defaults to the month name).

examples.title: Monday-first with blocked days
examples.description: Locale-aware week start and a predicate for holidays.

antiPatterns.title: Don't store Date objects
antiPatterns.explanation: A Date crossing a timezone boundary can land on the previous or next day. Keep ISO `YYYY-MM-DD` keys until you need to format them.

antiPatterns.title: Don't disable days by removing them
antiPatterns.explanation: Removing cells breaks the grid rhythm and keyboard movement. Mark them with min/max/isDateDisabled so they stay visible.

accessibility.implementation: role=grid with rows, columnheaders and gridcells; the month label is announced and polite.
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide aria-label when several calendars share a page.

accessibility.implementation: Arrows move by day/week, Home/End jump to week bounds, PageUp/PageDown change month, Enter/Space selects.
accessibility.userRequirements: One tab stop; roving tabindex keeps the grid compact.

accessibility.implementation: aria-selected on the gridcell and aria-current="date" for today.
accessibility.userRequirements: Do not communicate selection by colour alone.

guidelines: Use the full date as the accessible name
Keep visible cells to the day number

compositionRules.relationship: Wrap Calendar in PopoverContent for a date field
Use DatePickerPopover when the field and panel should ship together
